title: Rarible
html: Rarible is one of the most well-known peer-to-peer marketplaces for buying and selling non-fungible tokens (NFTs). Rarible allows users to buy, sell, and trade all different types of digital art, from digital versions of Nike basketball shoes, to paintings of famous crypto entrepreneurs like Vitalik Buterin, and anything in between. The Rarible marketplace, like most NFT marketplaces in the industry, accepts payments for NFTs in ether (ETH).
